title: Finite direct images of constructible sheaves
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be finite
with $S$ of finite type over $k$, and let $F$ be a
constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf on $X_{{\mathrm{et}}}$. Then the direct image
$f_*F$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is constructible on
$S_{{\mathrm{et}}}$ and $R^qf_*F=0$ for every $q>0$.

proof.text: Use the finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ fixed by [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]. The scheme $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian: its only prime is $(0)$, its only ideals are $(0),k$, and it is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to $S\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ to obtain that $S$ is Noetherian. On each of the finitely many strata trivializing $F$ as a finite constant $\Lambda$-module sheaf, forgetting scalars retains the same finite abelian group and the same covering. Thus the underlying abelian sheaf $F_{ab}$ is constructible in [def-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-sheaf].

source.place: Tag 01T6, lemma-finite-type-noetherian; blueprint proof, underlying finite constructible abelian sheaf

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-constructible-noetherian] to $f$ and $F_{ab}$, with the Noetherian base established in step 1. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact](1), the underlying abelian sheaf of the module direct image $G=f_*F$ is exactly $f_*F_{ab}$. By [def-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-sheaf], choose a finite constructible locally closed partition of $S$ on whose strata this abelian sheaf has etale trivializations $G_{ab}|_V\cong\underline M_V$ with $M$ a finite abelian group.

source.place: Proof: apply finite pushforward constructibility and choose the finite partition

proof.text: Fix one such trivialization over $V$. Write the abelian trivialization as $\phi:G_{ab}|_V\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline M_V$. For $\lambda\in\Lambda$, let $a_\lambda$ be multiplication by the constant scalar section $\lambda$ on $G|_V$, and define the abelian sheaf endomorphism $t_\lambda=\phi\circ a_\lambda\circ\phi^{-1}$ of $\underline M_V$. For each $(\lambda,m)\in\Lambda\times M$, the value $t_{\lambda,V}(m)$ on the constant section $m$ is a section $s_{\lambda,m}$ of $\underline M_V$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-sections-locally-constant] with $T=V$ and $E=M$: each $s_{\lambda,m}$ is a Zariski-locally constant function $|V|\to M$. Intersect their fibres to obtain a Zariski open partition of $V$ on which all these functions are simultaneously constant. There are only finitely many functions because both $\Lambda$ and $M$ are finite; there are only finitely many possible tuples of values. Discard empty pieces. On a nonempty piece $W$, define $\lambda\cdot m$ to be the corresponding constant value. The transported endomorphisms are additive and satisfy the module relations, so these values satisfy all the $\Lambda$-module axioms. Equality of constant values on nonempty $W$ is detected by their constant functions on $|W|$. Hence $M$ with this action is a finite $\Lambda$-module. For any etale object $T\to W$, apply the cited section theorem both to $M$ and to the additive group of $\Lambda$. A section of $\underline M(T)$ and a scalar section of $\Lambda_T(T)$ are Zariski-locally constant, so on an open covering of $T$ they equal constant values $m$ and $\lambda$. Naturality of $t_\lambda$ gives the fixed action formula on each such open. The sheaf axiom gives equality globally for every scalar section and module section. The abelian trivialization is therefore an isomorphism of $\Lambda$-module sheaves to the constant module sheaf with this action.

source.place: Proof: the finite action table on M and simultaneous refinement; Stacks 03P5 (remark-constant-locally-constant-maps) supplies the section description

proof.text: The open pieces $W$ of step 3 refine the etale covering of each stratum (open immersions and their composites with etale morphisms are etale by clauses (1)-(2) of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]). They cover every original trivialization, and the finite constructible partition of $S$ itself is unchanged. On each stratum $G$ is now etale-locally a constant finite $\Lambda$-module. This is precisely condition (b), with the original condition (a), of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Thus $f_*F$ is constructible.

source.place: Proof: thus the trivialization is one of constant Lambda-modules; morphisms.tex Tags 02GP (lemma-open-immersion-etale), 02GN (lemma-composition-etale)

proof.text: For any short exact sequence of $\Lambda$-module sheaves on $X$, forgetting the action gives a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves: by [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], kernels are sectionwise kernels and cokernels are sheafifications of sectionwise cokernels, so forgetting scalars retains these objects. Apply the exact abelian functor of [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]. Its resulting short exact sequence is the underlying abelian sequence of module direct images by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact](1). The same kernel and cokernel descriptions show it is exact as a module sequence. Thus module $f_*$ is exact. No claim that an injective module sheaf stays injective after forgetting its action is needed.

source.place: Tag 03QP, proposition-finite-higher-direct-image-zero; sites-modules.tex Tag 03DA, lemma-abelian, kernels and cokernels

proof.text: Take an injective resolution $0\to F\to I^0\to I^1\to\cdots$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$; existence and the computation $R^qf_*F=\mathcal H^q(f_*I^\bullet)$ are part of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], module-sheaf clause. Write $Z^j=\ker(I^j\to I^{j+1})$. For $j>0$ the resolution gives $0\to Z^{j-1}\to I^{j-1}\to Z^j\to0$. Exactness from step 5 makes $f_*I^{j-1}\to f_*Z^j$ surjective, while $f_*Z^j=\ker(f_*I^j\to f_*I^{j+1})$. Hence the image of the preceding differential equals the kernel of the next, and $\mathcal H^j(f_*I^\bullet)=0$ for every $j>0$. This proves the higher-direct-image clause in the module category.
